title: CI-VID: A Coherent Interleaved Text-Video Dataset

layout.note: The clip stack sits in a narrow left column; two caption cards (orange above, green below) fill the wide right column. Two curved colour-matched arrows run from the clips to the cards. White ground, no frame around the whole figure.

lesson: Draw a dataset sample as a media stack on the left and colour-coded annotation cards on the right, with matching-colour arrows starting from the exact item or dashed-framed group each caption describes. Underline the key spans of the new annotation type so the reader sees what the dataset adds.
